verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers IAM roles/permissions (bigquery-docs-31, bigquery-docs-65) and compliance certifications, with no mention of Cloud Audit Logs, job history, or column-level lineage tracking (e.g., Data Catalog/Dataplex lineage) for BigQuery. Governance/audit-and-lineage is a plausible and expected axis for a data warehouse, but no evidence in this pack substantiates it.
